question.text: Two types of opinions can be issued by an SIA per Section 5.15. These are:

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.15 lists two opinion types: 1. Unqualified or unmodified opinion (Clean Report) — no material mismanagement, sufficient and appropriate evidence. 2. Qualified or modified opinion — SIA unable to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence OR the impact report is not free from material mismanagement. The Trap: A is credit-rating vocabulary; C is equity-research vocabulary; D oversimplifies into a binary pass/fail that doesn't match assurance framework. Cross-Exam Context: Opinion taxonomy in ICAI financial-audit framework is similar; XXIII mirrors it for SIA. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Draft the opinion paragraph BEFORE the findings section — forcing yourself to articulate the opinion first usually reveals which findings are truly material and which are merely informative.
